education.detail: Intermediate, Siddhartha College (Board of Intermediate Education, AP), 1986; B.E. discontinued, Gulbarga University, Karnataka

declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. None of the 13 declared cases (11 pending, 2 convicted) reaches that threshold; sections involved are IPC 143/149/171F/188/189/269/271/283/341 and CrPC 151/107, all fine-only or capped well under 5 years. The two convictions (CC No.177/2020 and CC No.449/2021, both Addl. JFCM Court, Markapur) resulted in fines of Rs.100 and Rs.500 per accused respectively under IPC 188/189/269/283/143/149 and CrPC 252 -- no imprisonment was imposed.
